title: 4DAnyone Capture Studio
hero: Turn one ordinary clip into a camera array.
description: Recover the performer once, design a multi-ring virtual camera rig, and generate synchronized dense views for 4D reconstruction or creative replay. Every native output—motion, cameras, skeleton passes, proposal views, dense views, and timing metadata—stays available.
guide: Use a clear portrait clip with one visible performer and at least 121 usable frames. Start with six Turbo views, then expand to denser rings after validating the crop and motion solve.
runtime_contract: RTX 5090 · CUDA-only · no model CPU offload

models.label: DPVO learned camera recovery
models.note: Optional; SimpleVO is the default moving-camera solver

models.label: SMPL-X neutral body
models.note: Pinned and verified automatically by setup

setup_steps: Run `cd ~/multimedia/4d-ify && ./setupwithuv.sh` once; it installs and verifies the complete local runtime.
Run `./startwithuv.sh`, begin with the six-view Turbo preset, and inspect the synchronized output wall before increasing view density.

modes.title: Monocular → synchronized views
modes.short: Build a configurable virtual camera array around one performance.
modes.description: The complete native 4DAnyone path: canonicalize a 121-frame clip, recover GVHMR motion, make per-camera pose conditioning, generate proposal views when requested, and synthesize every dense view on one GPU.
modes.recipe: The rig diagram is represented explicitly by pitch rings, yaw origin, coverage, and views per ring. Total views must divide into six-view denoising groups.

fields.label: Monocular source video
fields.hint: One performer, clear body, modest camera motion, 1080p+ preferred, at least 121 usable frames.

fields.label: Camera solver
fields.hint: SimpleVO is efficient and handles ordinary handheld motion. DPVO uses the optional learned checkpoint. Static skips visual odometry.

fields.label: Full-frame focal length
fields.hint: 0 estimates intrinsics automatically. Typical phone lenses are 13, 24, 48, or 77 mm equivalent.

fields.label: Pitch rings
fields.hint: Degrees from -15 to 45. Add as many rings as needed.

fields.label: Views per ring
fields.hint: Ring count × this value must be divisible by six.

fields.label: Reference camera proposals
fields.toggle_label: Generate six proposal views before dense targets
fields.hint: Recommended when the rig contains more than six targets.

fields.label: Temporal cyclic regrouping
fields.toggle_label: Shift camera groups between denoising steps
fields.hint: Improves cross-view consistency for dense arrays.
